name: Skate or ray [wings]
definition: Raw skate or ray wings (Rajidae), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Skate wings sold skinless, two trimmed wings per pack, as skate wings

name: Ling
definition: Raw ling (Molva), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: British ling fillet sold frozen, one fillet per pack

name: Sprat [brisling]
definition: Raw sprat Sprattus sprattus, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Whole sprats sold in 260g pack, North Sea; listing sold out

name: Whiting
definition: Raw whiting Merlangius merlangus, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Fresh wild whiting fillet, Merlangius merlangus, skin on, boneless

name: Black sea bream
definition: Raw black sea bream (Spondyliosoma, Acanthopagrus), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Fresh wild black bream fillet, Spondyliosoma cantharus, skin on

name: Pouting [bib]
definition: Raw pouting Trisopterus luscus, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Seller species page for pouting, Trisopterus luscus, fresh from fishermen; no product listing

name: Red sea bream [madai]
definition: Raw red sea bream (Pagrus major, Pagrus pagrus), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Madai Pagrus major skin-on fillet, farmed Kagoshima, fresh or frozen

name: Flathead
definition: Raw flathead (Platycephalidae), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Tiger flathead, Neoplatycephalus richardsoni, sold whole and as fillets; other flatheads separate

name: Sillago whiting [King George whiting; kisu]
definition: Raw sillago or King George whiting (Sillaginidae), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: King George whiting, Sillaginodes, sold whole, trunks, single and butterflied fillets

name: Garfish [sayori]
definition: Raw garfish or halfbeak (Belonidae, Hemiramphidae), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Garfish large IQF 5kg pack, imported, Australian wholesaler

name: Blue cod
definition: Raw New Zealand blue cod Parapercis colias, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Blue cod fillets skinned boned, fresh, wild Chatham Islands; listing out of stock

name: Hanger steak
definition: beef steak from the hanging tender of the diaphragm (onglet).
notes: Ex-dairy onglet (hanger steak) sold as British grass-fed beef cut

name: Wood pigeon, whole or jointed
definition: wood pigeon or squab sold whole or as breasts (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: Wild wood pigeon breasts, frozen, four per pack, Devon

name: Squirrel
definition: squirrel meat sold whole or jointed to eat.
notes: Whole oven-ready grey squirrel, skinned, about 225g, one per person
